close_reason: clippy::pedantic only (.map(|s| s.as_ref()) → method ref). Closure form is idiomatic and self-documenting; method-ref form requires explicit AsRef path that's noisier in test code. Won't fix in 0.1.x; revisit if/when workspace adopts clippy::pedantic in CI.
description: Three call sites — src/sse.rs:151, src/sse.rs:172, src/ws/mod.rs:293 — use `.map(|s| s.as_ref())`. Clippy::pedantic redundant_closure suggests `.map(std::convert::AsRef::as_ref)` or, more readably for these, `.map(String::as_str)` since the closure is over State (which is String-backed). All three are in test code, not production. Filing as opinion-tagged because clippy default doesn't flag this and the closure form is arguably clearer to a test reader. Note: locked crate.
title: .map(|s| s.as_ref()) closures that could be method references
